payout_quote: Clinical Research of West Florida official FAQ pages (crwf.com): knee osteoarthritis trial - 'can receive up to $1,875 in compensation for completed office visits and diagnostic testing' (approximately 25 office visits over 65 weeks); elevated lipoprotein trial - 'can receive up to $1,568 in compensation for time and travel upon completion' (up to 4 years); Sjogren's Syndrome trial - 'can receive up to $1,600 in compensation for time and travel' (approximately 16 visits over 65 weeks); gout trial - 'can receive up to $450 in compensation for time and travel' (up to 4 visits over 36 days); COPD trial - 'can receive up to $1,300 in compensation for time and travel' (approximately 9 office visits); cutaneous lupus trial - 'compensation up to $1,800 for time and travel'.
steps: Open Clinical Research of West Florida's official clinical-studies pages (crwf.com) and pick a current study matching your condition (e.g. knee osteoarthritis, elevated lipoprotein, Sjogren's, gout, COPD, cutaneous lupus).
Contact CRWF or complete the online eligibility form for that study.
Confirm eligibility through a screening visit with the study team (e.g. knee OA: 50+, BMI 18-39, not on chronic blood thinners or opiates; not everyone qualifies).
Attend the scheduled office visits (e.g. ~25 visits over 65 weeks for knee OA); study-related care is at no cost and no health insurance is required.

Receive compensation up to the study's ceiling (e.g. up to $1,875 for knee OA; up to $1,600 Sjogren's; up to $1,568 elevated lipoprotein; up to $1,300 COPD; up to $1,800 cutaneous lupus; up to $450 gout).
catches: You must medically qualify for a specific study and pass screening; not everyone qualifies.
All amounts are 'up to' ceilings tied to completing all visits and tests; the longest studies (OA, Sjogren's) run 65 weeks.
The representative knee OA trial runs approximately 25 office visits over 65 weeks - this is a long-term, repeated-visit commitment before the full $1,875 ceiling is earned.
Trials test investigational products with real medical risks and side effects.
Studies are on-site in Clearwater or Tampa, Florida - you must attend clinic visits there.
Compensation varies widely by study ($450-$1,875); the representative $1,875 applies only to the knee OA trial.
biggest_catch: You must qualify for a condition-specific study and attend on-site visits in the Tampa Bay area over months to years; compensation is an 'up to' ceiling paid only for completing visits and testing, with real investigational-product risks.
eligibility: Study-specific: knee OA (50+, BMI 18-39, not on chronic blood thinners or opiates); elevated lipoprotein (55+, cardiovascular risk factors); Sjogren's (diagnosis + antibody history); gout (18+, gout diagnosis, flare in last year); COPD (40-80, 10+ pack years); final eligibility confirmed at screening.
timing: Compensation upon completion of office visits and testing; study-related care at no cost; no health insurance required.
